guide.animal.effects: Mark enemy animals. The "Beastwarden" and "Caerlin's Blessing" provide animal armor that is effective against such enemies.
guide.archer-skill_arcane_flight.intro: Imbues fired projectiles with random elemental (fire, ice, or lightning) damage bonus.
guide.archer-skill_barbed_arrows.intro: Ranged shot with 50% chance to inflict Bleed.
guide.archer-skill_cloak_of_swiftness.in: Increases the ranger's evasion, ranged hit chance, unarmed damage and ranged critical hit chance.
guide.archer-skill_execution_shot.intro: High-damage shooting. Additional +40% damage is applied to marked targets.
guide.archer-skill_execution_shot.notes:
- Usable only with ranged weapons
Cause additional damage to targets affected by the Hunter's Prey or Mark the Dead
guide.archer-skill_hunters_prey.intro: Marks a close enemy for 3 rounds. All damage they receive from any source is increased by +20%.
guide.archer-skill_quickshot.intro: Ranged attack with a chance to shoot twice. The second shot does not trigger weapon effects or critical hits.
guide.archer-skill_skirmishers_step.intr: Grants the ranger bonus evasion for 1 round and increases the ranger's next basic attack damage by +20%.
guide.archer-skill_skirmishers_step.note:
- Does not consume an action
Does not stack with itself
guide.archer-skill_stillstrike.intro: Ranged shot with a 25% chance to Paralyze the target for 1 round.
guide.archer-skill_stillstrike.notes:
- Usable only with ranged weapons
Stunned targets can still move
guide.archer-skill_take_aim.intro: Precise ranged shot with increased damage and critical chance.
guide.archer.intro: Rangers specialize in marking enemies, precision shots, and sustained ranged pressure. They enhance their arrows with different effects, allowing them to adjust their damage.
guide.archer.lore: The Ranger shapes the battlefield from afar. By controlling distance and selecting priority targets, the Ranger weakens the enemy formation before it can engage.
guide.aura_of_blades.effects: The entire team's melee attacks increase by 1 to 5 points, with an additional 1 point for each level. A Voidcaller can only activate one type of aura at a time.
guide.aura_of_the_void.effects: The Voidcaller shields the whole party against all damage. The shield regenerates every 100 turns. Its capacity at skill levels 1–5 is 6, 11, 16, 21 and 26, respectively.
guide.aura_of_the_void.effects-2: All three types of auras share the same level, and only one type can be activated at a time.
guide.aura_of_thorns.effects: When the entire team is subjected to melee attacks, 10% to 30% of the damage is reflected back onto the attacker. This percentage increases by 5 points for each level. A Voidcaller can only activate one type of aura at a time.
guide.barlo_doll.steps: Accept a request from Barlo within the village to retrieve lost items.
guide.barlo_doll.steps-2: Enter the Rat Nest on the east side of the Fangroot Forest and retrieve Barlo's doll from the treasure chest.
guide.barlo_doll.steps-3: Bring the doll back to the village and give it to Barlo.
guide.barlo_five_mushrooms.note: The reward for returning the Swampling is mutually exclusive with this task.
guide.barlo_five_mushrooms.stage: Give the five mushrooms to Barlo
guide.barlo_five_mushrooms.steps: First, complete the "Rag Doll Run", then talk to Barlo and ask about the five escaped mushrooms.
guide.barlo_five_mushrooms.steps-2: Find five different living mushrooms in the village, bring them all to Barlo, and he will pay you for them.
guide.barlo_five_mushrooms.steps-3: To complete The Missing Five and gain the mycelial bond, give the mushrooms to the mushroom mother at the forest edge. You can only give them to one recipient.
guide.battle_roar.effects: All team members receive +15% physical damage, melee damage, and ranged damage; +3% critical rate, lasting for 3 rounds. With each level increase, the damage boost increases by 5 percentage points, and the critical rate increases by 3 percentage points.
guide.big_mushroom_revolt.facts-2: When you have not yet chosen "Agree to help them" in the Mushroom Fields in the East Garden, talk to the Frog King with a Wizard, Blood Mage, or Slugman. Use the profession or race option to interact with the Frog King. Choose "Let it in." or "Open its mind." Then approach the Fountain and sacrifice blood to the Frog King. If you have already chosen "Agree to help them" in the Mushroom Fields, sacrificing blood to the Frog King will trigger a rebellious battle.
guide.big_mushroom_revolt.note: The selected team member gains the Mark of the Frog, providing permanent +25% toxin resistance, immunity to diseases, and a 10% reduction in flame resistance.
guide.big_mushroom_revolt.stage: Sacrifice blood to the designated team member
guide.big_mushroom_revolt.stage-2: Killed the Frog King and preserved the colony, completing the rebellion
guide.big_mushroom_revolt.steps: First, return five living mushrooms to the swampling, and obtain a connection to the mushroom colony. Go to the mushroom field in the east of the Soul Forging Furnace, touch the mycelium, and communicate with it.
guide.big_mushroom_revolt.steps-2: In the Mushroom Field, inquire about the resistance plan of the fungi. Choose "Agree to help them." Proceed to the next task. When meeting with the Frog King, accept his telepathic message. Approach the fountain and have the designated team member donate blood, triggering a counterattack from the fungi.
guide.big_mushroom_revolt.steps-3: Defeat the Frog King to preserve the members of the fungal group. Refusing to cooperate or killing the green mushrooms will undermine the rebellion.
guide.bleed.effects: Life is lost based on the degree of bleeding per round. Repeated bleeding will extend the duration. The default setting is 1 point of life loss per round, lasting for 3 rounds. The actual intensity and duration depend on the source.
guide.blessing_of_the_wolf_queen.effects: Pray at the statue in Caerlin Woods to gain +2 armor against animals for 500 turns.
guide.blind.effects: Melee and ranged hit chance is reduced by 50%. Blindness lasts 1 turn by default. Reapplying blindness extends the duration.
guide.blood-mage-bone-use: Blood Mage can consume bones while casting skills, thereby reducing the life cost of some skills.
guide.blood_pact.effects: Marks the enemy for 2 turns. When the caster is damaged, the target also suffers 20% to 100% of that damage. The percentage increases by 20 points at each level.
guide.bloodmage-skill_blood_lance.intro: Ranged Blood spell with a chance to apply Bleed.
guide.bloodmage-skill_blood_pact.intro: Marks an enemy and reflects damage you take to it.
guide.bloodmage-skill_blood_pact.table-2: Life consumption when bones are not used
guide.bloodmage-skill_bloodfall.intro: Strikes two enemies three times with a chance to inflict Bleed.
guide.bloodmage-skill_crimson_renewal.in: Sacrifices health to heal an ally.
guide.bloodmage-skill_exsanguinate.intro: Increases Bleed damage and extends Bleed duration on a bleeding enemy.
guide.bloodmage-skill_leechcraft.intro: Lifesteal: Restores health equal to 10% of blood damage you deal.
Blood spells that deal damage gain critical chance.
Buff Chance of Blood Mage Spell
guide.bloodmage-skill_scarlet_shackles.i: Roots all close enemies and applies Bleed.
guide.bloodmage.intro:
A Skeleton is required for a Blood Mage to cast a spell. When there is no remains, They pay with their own blood.

Their magic is centered around blood damage and execution methods: Mark targets, Cause bleeding, And release destructive blood spells.

Although stamina is the primary attribute,, If you plan to use magical equipment,, A Blood Mage should also consider wisdom.
guide.bloodmage.lore: The Blood Mage draws strength from death and blood. Power is never free, and every spell demands a cost.
guide.bonus_armor.effects: Armor +5, basic duration: 3 turns. Can be obtained with “Ironhide Potion”.
guide.bonus_elemental_resistance.effects: Resistance to Fire, Frost, Lightning, Fresh Blood, and Poison: +20% each. Basic duration: 3 turns. Can be obtained with “Wardstone Elixir”.
guide.bonus_evasion.effects: Dodge +20, basic duration: 3 turns. Can be obtained with “Ghoststep Draught”.
guide.burn.effects: For each turn, damage from Fire can be mitigated by resistance to Fire. Rekindling will extend the duration, while the damage per turn remains unchanged. Default setting: 1 point per turn, duration: 3 turns.
guide.caerlin_head.note: Opening hidden passages grants the entire team “Caerlin’s Blessing”. Armor for animals +2, duration: 500 turns.
guide.caerlin_head.stage: Use the exclusive dialogue of a Wizard or Blood Mage when investigating the statue
guide.caerlin_head.stage-2: Place the Wolf Skull back on the statue
guide.caerlin_head.steps: Investigate the statue in Caerlin Woods for wolves missing their heads.
guide.caerlin_head.steps-2: Go to the "Cells of the Forgotten" in the tomb and retrieve the Wolf Skull from the treasure chest.
guide.caerlin_head.steps-3: Return to the statue to place the skull, and open any hidden passages nearby.
guide.champions_grip.effects: Increase physical damage, melee damage, and ranged damage by 20%, and gain immunity to dizziness for 4 rounds. As level increases, the damage boost increases by another 7 percentage points.
guide.characters.effects: Restore 5 Mana or Stamina when a nearby enemy dies.
guide.characters.effects-10: When health drops below 30%, gain +4 base damage and +4% critical hit rate.
guide.characters.effects-12: +10% base damage (melee and ranged) against enemies below 50% Health.
guide.characters.effects-14: Melee attacks restore 5% of damage dealt as Health.
guide.characters.effects-16: 40% chance to survive a fatal injury with 1 point of health.
guide.characters.effects-22: 50% chance to avoid spell damage. If hit, receives +100% spell damage.
guide.characters.effects-23: 5% chance to become poisoned during attacks.
guide.characters.effects-3: Deal 1-4 Lightning damage to attackers on melee hit.
guide.characters.effects-30: 5% chance to be knocked out during attacks.
guide.characters.effects-34: -2 Strength when global food is under 10.
guide.characters.effects-35: All spells cost +1 Mana to cast.
guide.characters.effects-36: When eating or drinking potions, there is a 10% chance of a small-scale explosion, causing flame damage.
guide.characters.effects-37: There is a 50% chance to attack random enemies ahead of the team, rather than the target you choose.
guide.characters.effects-4: Reflect 5% physical damage to the attacker (stacks with other damage reflection effects).
guide.characters.effects-40: Healing potions heal double. Poison effects deal double damage.
guide.characters.effects-41: Any Ice damage automatically freezes you for 2 rounds.
guide.characters.effects-8: Melee attacks inflict Bleed for 3 rounds (1 damage).
guide.characters.effects-9: When hit by a melee attack, there is a 5% chance to stun the attacker for 1 turn. Has no effect on targets immune to stun.
guide.characters.name: Gravemind Link
guide.consecrated_ground.effects: While on consecrated ground, the party gains +1 armor and +5% fire, ice and lightning resistance for 1 turn. Each skill level adds 1 armor, 4 percentage points of resistance and 1 turn.
guide.demon.effects: Enemies with demon types are marked. Enemies such as Cinderling, Ashmaw, and Blood Golem carry this mark.
guide.disease.effects: During rest, recovery of health, mana, or stamina is impossible. All regeneration effects are temporarily paused. The base duration is 5 turns, and the duration increases if the enemy is re-infected.
guide.dragon_quest.note: Korr and two dwarves temporarily join the party.
guide.dragon_quest.note-2: Both endings complete the quest and unlock the achievement. See Heart of the Mountain for Durok’s reward.
guide.dragon_quest.stage-2: The extermination route involves killing dragons
guide.dragon_quest.stage-3: Drive away the ancient dragon or kill the dragon itself
guide.dragon_quest.stage-4: Speak to Korr back at camp after driving off the dragon
guide.dragon_quest.steps: Talk to Captain Korr Stonehammer at the dwarven camp in Duskhollow Woods and join his hunt for the Ancient Dragon.
guide.dragon_quest.steps-2: Campaign route: Place explosive barrels at three locations around the dragon’s nest. After detonating them, defeat the ancient dragon.
guide.dragon_quest.steps-3: At the dwarven camp, promise Durok to spare the Ancient Dragon, then join Korr’s expedition. Choose to reason with Korr at each of the three barrel encounters. The third attempt stops the plan before the fuses are lit. Break the pillars in the lair to drive the dragon away.
guide.druid_fallen_obelisk.note: A conversation with an elk earns 40 experience points, while a conversation with a slugman earns 25 experience points.
guide.druid_fallen_obelisk.stage: Refer to "The Last Guardian" and talk to a Druid
guide.druid_fallen_obelisk.stage-3: Return to the forest and report the findings
guide.druid_fallen_obelisk.stage-4: Talk to the Druid about the racial branches
guide.druid_fallen_obelisk.steps: Conversing with a Druid near the roots of Underkeep.
guide.druid_fallen_obelisk.steps-2: Descend from the northwest entrance to "Depths of the Broken Seal", find the shattered obelisks, and determine the cause of its collapse.
guide.druid_fallen_obelisk.steps-3: Return to the woodland and inform the Druids. If the Druids are already hostile, this reward path will be interrupted.
guide.durok_dragon.note: Complete the mission with a peaceful outcome.
guide.durok_dragon.note-2: The branch with a failed mission is mutually exclusive with the rewards for a peaceful outcome.
guide.durok_dragon.stage: Reported to Durok after driving away the dragon
guide.durok_dragon.stage-2: Received the mission. Reported to Durok after killing the dragon
guide.durok_dragon.steps: At the dwarven camp, promise Durok to spare the Ancient Dragon, then join Korr’s expedition.
guide.durok_dragon.steps-2: Choose to reason with Korr at each of the three barrel encounters. The third attempt stops the plan before the fuses are lit. Break the pillars in the lair to drive the dragon away.
guide.durok_dragon.steps-3: Return to Durok and inform him that the dragon has left. Exploding the explosives or killing the dragon would ruin this peaceful outcome.
guide.dwarf.effect-2: Be able to see things that regular vision cannot detect.
guide.dwarf.intro: Dwarves are naturally strong and exceptionally resilient. They excel in physical roles but are less attuned to agility and arcane disciplines.
guide.dwarf.lore: Born beneath mountains and tempered in the dark, dwarves are stone given will. Their bodies are stout, their endurance unyielding, and their tempers as sharp as their axes. Slow to trust yet fierce in loyalty, they endure as rock endures, unmoved by storm or age, until all else crumbles to dust.
guide.dwarf_beer_bonus.effects: After consuming "Dwarven Forgebrew", fire resistance increases by 2% permanently. Reconsumption can stack over time.
guide.eight_keys.note: Open the sealed door of the Soul Forging Furnace lobby.
guide.eight_keys.stage: Provide 8 blue key spheres at once
guide.eight_keys.steps: Explore the eight-hole sealing door in the outside hall of the Soul Forging furnace.
guide.eight_keys.steps-2: There are 4 blue key spheres in each of the East Garden and West Garden. Open the items below to view the eight coordinates.
guide.eight_keys.steps-3: Collect all 8 key spheres and return to the sealing door. Hand over all the key spheres at once to open the path leading deeper into the ruins.
guide.elk.intro: Elk favor agility and wisdom over brute force. They thrive in precision-based and magical roles.
guide.elk.lore: Elks are reclusive wanderers, masters of the untamed wilderness. Their keen senses rival the sharpest hunters, and their connection to the land allows them to move unseen. Elks craft illusions, weave nature's energy, and glimpse distant futures in the wind's whispers.
guide.evasive_roll.effects: Dodge +10, lasting for 2 turns. With each level increase, the dodge bonus increases by 5 points. Learning this skill also increases the maximum dodge by 2 percentage points per level.
guide.find_khelebar.note: Each has its own trigger conditions. You can obtain the Ranger Dagger from the dialogue in the hidden locations of Rangers or Thieves. You can get the Red Mask from the investigation branch of Blood Mages.
guide.find_khelebar.note-2: You can obtain the Mortar and Pestle and take Jacob's letter with you.
guide.find_khelebar.note-3: This branch directly leads to the cottage mission, which is mutually exclusive with the normal rewards of "Shadows of the South".
guide.find_khelebar.note-4: After obtaining the ring, continue with "Shadows of the South".
guide.find_khelebar.stage: Use the special profession options in Jacob's cottage
guide.find_khelebar.stage-3: When looking for Khelebar for the first time, Jacob has already been rescued
guide.find_khelebar.stage-4: Follow the general route to Khelebar and inquire about Jacob
guide.find_khelebar.steps: Investigate Jacob’s cottage in the Fangroot Forest and read the clues he left behind.
guide.find_khelebar.steps-2: Enter the Village of Underkeep to find Khelebar, inquire about Jacob’s whereabouts, and continue with “Shadows of the South”.
guide.freeze.effects: Skip turns during the freezing period. Frost resistance reduces the likelihood of freezing; the basic duration is 1 turn, and repeated freezing will extend the duration.
guide.grave-dig-source: Dig grave · Obtain randomly (Requires a Shovel and 1 portion of food)
guide.grave-dig-use: Dig shallow graves, consuming an additional 1 portion of food for each grave.
guide.grgla_creature.note: Complete “Misty Maze” simultaneously. Both tasks share this experience value.
guide.grgla_creature.stage: Talk with Grgla and accept his gift
guide.grgla_creature.stage-2: Follow Grgla out of the mist
guide.grgla_creature.steps: Meet Grgla in the swamp. Drive off the tree monsters that pursue him to his hideout, then speak to him again.
guide.grgla_creature.steps-2: First reach the Mist Labyrinth, then return to his hiding place to ask about the paths in the mist. Let him lead you there.
guide.grgla_creature.steps-3: Take him through the thick mist until you reach the exit.
guide.health_regeneration.effects: Throw a healing potion into the swamp boss’s open mouth to make it regain 10 HP every turn indefinitely.
guide.horemount.effect: It is not possible to equip body armor. +1 armor is obtained at levels 1, 5, 9, and 13.
guide.horemount.intro: Stoneborn possess exceptional strength and resilience, making them dominant in physical roles. Their heavy build limits agility and their rigid nature makes arcane paths very demanding.
guide.horemount.lore: Towering warriors of the northern mountains, the Stoneborns are living rock, shaped by the relentless winds and icy peaks. Their bodies are massive, their presence imposing, and their endurance unmatched. When they take a stand, few forces can move them.
guide.hp_shield.effects: The enemy's Armor Shell. The initial strength of the swamp tentacles is 2, while that of the swamp leader and the Archmage of the Underkeep in the first stage is 5. If Ironhide Potion is poured into the mouth of the swamp leader, his Armor Shell will increase by another 5 points.
guide.human.intro: Humans are adaptable and balanced, without extreme strengths or weaknesses. They fit naturally into any role within the party.
guide.human.lore: Restless and short-lived, fierce, and brief. Their strength is not in blood or bone, but in will. The hunger to shape, to conquer, to endure. Humans thrive where older races falter, leaving their mark on every land they touch.
guide.hunters_prey.effects: The Ranger marks a nearby enemy for 3 turns, increasing the damage it takes by 20%–40%. Each skill level adds 5 percentage points.
guide.invisibility.effects: Make the entire team invisible, avoiding enemy sight and spells. The skill lasts for 3 to 7 turns, with an increase of 1 turn per level. It is lifted by active attacks or direct movements.
guide.iron_and_ash.note: Each item has its own amount of experience points, and the selected equipment is obtained.
guide.iron_and_ash.stage: Forge a Moonsteel Helmet, Gloves or boots
guide.iron_and_ash.steps: In Duskhollow Woods, ask Brenna about ancient ores. Bring Moonsteel Ore to let her identify it.
guide.iron_and_ash.steps-2: Prepare 1 piece of Moonsteel Ore and 50 gold coins. You can choose a helmet, gloves, boots, or shield; a chestplate requires 2 pieces of ore. You must have 100 gold coins on you, leaving a total of 50 coins. The task is completed upon the first forging.
guide.ixarion_companion.note: There are corresponding options for Thieves, Blood Mages, Wizards, or Elks.
guide.ixarion_companion.note-3: Iksarion joins temporarily. This branch is mutually exclusive with the destruction formation.
guide.ixarion_companion.stage: Use the exclusive dialogue when investigating the pentagram
guide.ixarion_companion.stage-3: Complete the summoning and defeat Iksarion
guide.ixarion_companion.steps: Explore the pentagram and ritual book in the tomb’s secret chamber. To recruit demons, first preserve the magic circle.
guide.ixarion_companion.steps-2: Obtain the Scroll of Binding from the tomb treasure chest, return to the magic circle with your true name, and complete the summoning process.
guide.ixarion_companion.steps-3: Defeat Ik-Sarion and have him serve in the tomb temporarily. If the destruction of the ritual formation is chosen, the ceremony will end immediately.
guide.jacob_rescue.stage-2: After releasing it, the hand axe was returned to him
guide.jacob_rescue.stage-3: Return to the village and report to Khelebar
guide.jacob_rescue.steps: Ask Khelebar about Jacob within the village. Head to the southern cemetery to find his letter.
guide.jacob_rescue.steps-2: Enter the tomb and find Jacob in the "Cells of the Forgotten". Release him.
guide.jacob_rescue.steps-3: Return to the village and inform Khelebar of Jacob’s survival.
guide.jacob_source.note-2: Muting the source leads to mission failure.
guide.jacob_source.stage: End the suffering of the source
guide.jacob_source.stage-3: Destroy the source and return to the village to inform Khelebar
guide.jacob_source.steps: After rescuing Jacob, talk with him about the source of the sect.
guide.jacob_source.steps-2: Enter "Chambers of Endless Sleep", defeat the guards, and investigate the source.
guide.jacob_source.steps-3: Choose to end the suffering of the source to complete the mission; if you let it live, the mission will fail.
guide.khelebar_stone.stage-2: Copy the second obelisk in the Druid Forest
guide.khelebar_stone.stage-3: Use the Wizard-specific dialogue at the second obelisk
guide.khelebar_stone.stage-4: Copy the third obelisk in the secret area
guide.khelebar_stone.stage-5: Copy the fourth obelisk in the half-orc camp
guide.khelebar_stone.stage-6: After copying everything, report to Khelebar
guide.khelebar_stone.steps: Accept the mission to copy runes from Khelebar in the village.
guide.khelebar_stone.steps-2: Go to "Depths of the Broken Seal" and investigate the broken obelisk in the northwest.
guide.khelebar_stone.steps-3: The "Roots of Underkeep" also records three other locations: the Druid forest in the northeast, the hidden clearing in the southwest, and the half-orc camp in the southeast.
guide.khelebar_stone.steps-4: After recording everything everywhere, return to Khelebar to deliver the runes and obtain the Teleportation Stone.
guide.lantern_quest.note: It is mutually exclusive with other summoning methods.
guide.lantern_quest.note-2: Defeating the guards also grants 250 experience points. The Lantern Key and Ectoplasm come from the drops.
guide.lantern_quest.note-3: This is mutually exclusive with defeating the Soul Warden at the end.
guide.lantern_quest.stage: Blood Mage checks the torches in the birch forest
guide.lantern_quest.stage-2: Summon the guardian using the Voidcaller ability or Voidshard in the nameless tomb
guide.lantern_quest.stage-3: Use the Spirit Lantern to summon the Warden
guide.lantern_quest.stage-4: Defeat the Soul Warden at the end
guide.lantern_quest.stage-5: Choose to break the lantern at the end, Release both sides
guide.lantern_quest.steps: Investigate the spirit lanterns in the white birch forest of Duskhollow Woods. First, protect the lanterns and listen to the clues from the spirit.
guide.lantern_quest.steps-2: Find the lone grave with the burned cross. Use the Voidcaller, Void Shard or Spirit Lantern dialogue option to summon the guardian.
guide.lantern_quest.steps-3: Have the guard follow the group back to the white birch forest. Then trigger the final event of the lantern and resolve the guard. Killing it on the way will result in a ending that allows the spirit to rest in peace.
guide.lockpick-use: Use the Lockpick Tools to open the designated locked treasure chest. Use one tool each time.
guide.mark_of_the_frog.effects: Members who offer blood to the Frog King will permanently gain +25% toxin resistance and disease immunity. Their fire resistance will be reduced by 10%.
guide.mark_the_dead.effects: Mark nearby enemies, increasing all damage they receive by 20%–40% for 2 turns. The percentage increases by 5 points at each level.
guide.mausoleum_entry.note: It can be accessed through the main entrance.
guide.mausoleum_entry.note-2: There are corresponding options for Paladin, Wizard, Ranger, and Thief.
guide.mausoleum_entry.stage: Solve the riddle of the tombstone markers
guide.mausoleum_entry.stage-2: Say the correct password at the mausoleum entrance
guide.mausoleum_entry.stage-3: Use special class options at the entrance
guide.mausoleum_entry.steps: Survey the stone gate at the mausoleum entrance of Underkeep Cemetery.
guide.mausoleum_entry.steps-2: Decipher the secret message “The blood of the Watcher still nourishes the roots” using it at the main entrance. You can also bypass the guards through a secret entrance that is hidden from view by the roots on the side of the mausoleum.
guide.mausoleum_entry.steps-3: If you try to break through the main entrance without obtaining the password, the believers will detect your presence and attack you.
guide.mayor_bracelet.note: Designate a member to receive 1 skill point.
guide.mayor_bracelet.stage: Return the bracelet and choose a party member to train
guide.mayor_bracelet.steps: Complete “Bells of Underkeep”, then ask Aldren about the bracelet. Enter the Wolf Den from Caerlin Woods.
guide.mayor_bracelet.steps-2: Find the bracelet deep in the Wolf Den and return it to Aldren. It appears in your inventory as the Amulet of Remembrance.
guide.mayor_first_quest.note: Each of the Paladin, Blood Mage, or Ranger has corresponding branches.
guide.mayor_first_quest.note-2: Tell the truth or lie; both paths offer the same rewards.
guide.mayor_first_quest.stage: Investigate the exclusive dialogue used when infecting miners
guide.mayor_first_quest.stage-3: Report the whereabouts of the miners to Aldren
guide.mayor_first_quest.steps: Ask Aldren about the four missing miners in the village.
guide.mayor_first_quest.steps-2: Enter Caerlin Woods from the Kaelin Forest. Investigate the first miner and gather notes. Continue searching for infected miners deeper within the area.
guide.mayor_first_quest.steps-3: Proceed further into the mine tunnels, defeat the living crystal "The Shattered," discover the fate of the miners, and then return to the village to report to Aldren.
guide.mayor_orc_attack.note: This stage is about battle experience and drops.
guide.mayor_orc_attack.stage-2: Reported that the bandit chief has been defeated
guide.mayor_orc_attack.stage-3: Show the bandit's orders to Aldren
guide.mayor_orc_attack.steps: After the village alarm sounds, go to the western gate to repel the half-orcs that have invaded the village. Then return to talk with Aldren.
guide.mayor_orc_attack.steps-2: Follow the trail to the bandit camp at “Roots of Underkeep” and defeat the leader.
guide.mayor_orc_attack.steps-3: Return to the village and report to Aldren. If the leader has already been killed, you can report directly.
guide.misty_maze.note: Unlock the achievement. Use this experience value together with “There and Grgla Again”.
guide.misty_maze.stage: Lead Grgla out of the mist
guide.misty_maze.steps: In Grimfen, walk through the misty maze, causing the team to discover that the path is blocked.
guide.misty_maze.steps-2: Save Grgla, then return to inquire about the maze. Invite him to join you, and then head to the maze’s exit together.
guide.muddy.effects: After getting stuck in the mud, dodge by −15. The basic duration is 5 turns.
guide.mushroom_bond.effects: After returning five mushrooms to the mushroom kin, the entire team gains a connection. The mushroom monster will remain neutral, and the team can also communicate with the mushrooms in the mushroom fields.
guide.mushroom_bond.effects-2: The team transforms into mushrooms approximately every 100 to 200 turns, lasting for 1 to 2 turns. During the transformation, all attributes are reduced to 1.
guide.mushroom_brew.note: Each of the 10 flowers delivered costs 5 gold coins.
guide.mushroom_brew.stage: Collect 10 Green Alecaps and deliver them to Brenna
guide.mushroom_brew.steps: Go to the dwarf camp in Duskhollow Woods and discuss brewing materials with Brenna.
guide.mushroom_brew.steps-2: Collect 10 Green Alecaps. Return to the camp with them and report the mushrooms to Brenna.
guide.ooze_corrosion.effects: Armor decreases based on corrosion intensity. The default setting is -1 armor, lasting for 1 to 4 turns. The duration increases if corrosion occurs again.
guide.ooze_cube_large.abilities: Upon death, split into two Ooze Cubes at the original location
guide.paladin-skill_consecrated_ground.i: Creates holy ground that strengthens the party's defenses while they remain within it.
guide.paladin-skill_consecrated_ground.n: Lasts for 1 turn, or until the team leaves
Consumes Zeal to deal fire damage and possibly stun the enemy.

All enthusiasm consumed
Each point of enthusiasm causes 3 flame damage
There is a 15% chance of dizziness for 1 turn
guide.paladin-skill_judgment.intro: Consumes Zeal to deliver a powerful holy strike that deals increased damage, especially to Undead and Demons.
guide.paladin-skill_judgment.notes:
All enthusiasm consumed
Causes 120% base damage
The expended enthusiasm at each point increases the additional damage
Additional damage is applied to Undead and Demons
guide.paladin-skill_lay_on_hands.intro: Consumes Zeal to heal an ally. Higher levels allow more Zeal to be consumed.
guide.paladin-skill_lay_on_hands.notes:
Consumes 1/2/3/4/5 points of enthusiasm based on skill level
Each point of enthusiasm restores 3 health points
guide.paladin-skill_lay_on_hands.table: Restores vitality with each point of enthusiasm
guide.paladin-skill_lay_on_hands.table-2: Consumes the maximum amount of enthusiasm
guide.paladin-skill_righteous_strike.int: Empowers the next basic attack, increasing its damage and generating extra Zeal.
guide.paladin-skill_righteous_strike.not:
- Does not consume an action
Increases damage of the next basic attack +15%
The next successful basic attack generates an additional 1 point of enthusiasm
Effects do not stack
guide.paladin-skill_sacred_bulwark.intro: Passively adds Armor equal to 20% of the Paladin's Wisdom.
guide.paladin-skill_stun_undead.intro: Consumes Zeal to attempt to stun a single Undead enemy.
guide.paladin-skill_stun_undead.notes:
Initial skills
Cannot be upgraded
All enthusiasm consumed
Each point of enthusiasm consumed has a 20% chance of causing dizziness
Dizziness lasts for 1 turn
guide.paladin-skill_stun_undead.table: The dizziness rate of each point of enthusiasm
guide.paladin-skill_zealous_resolve.intr: Increases melee damage for each current Zeal charge.
guide.paladin.intro:
Paladins excel in defense, Healing and sacred punishment. They stand at the front line, Protect allies and restore their strength, Particularly effective against Undead and Demons. Successful base attacks will accumulate enthusiasm, Up to 5 points. Enthusiasm is used to enhance skills, Gradually dissipates outside of combat

Strength is the primary attribute, But if you want to use a wider range of equipment…, Paladins should also consider wisdom and agility.
guide.paladin.lore: A warrior of faith, tempered by battle. Clad in armor and guided by unwavering faith, he protects the weak and brings righteous judgment upon the unholy.
guide.paladin_divine_guard.effects: After consuming enthusiasm, a Paladin gains armor +1 to +5, lasting for 1 turn. The level of armor increases by 1 point per level.
guide.paralyze.effects: A paralyzed character cannot move. If any party member is paralyzed, the whole party cannot move. Paralysis lasts 1 turn by default, and reapplying it extends the duration.
guide.permanent_mana_up.effects: After consuming “Caerlin Essence”, a character with mana ability permanently gains an additional 5 mana points per consumption.
guide.poison.effects: The character suffers poison damage at the beginning of each turn. Resistance to poison reduces this damage. Even if resistance reaches 100%, the character still loses at least 1 point of life per turn.
guide.poison.effects-2: Endurance affects how long poison lasts. Reapplying poison adds to its remaining duration. Only a stronger poison increases the damage per turn. The default is 2 damage per turn for 2 turns.
guide.provoking_shout.effects: In the next 2 turns, each time the enemy attacks the team, there is a 40%–100% chance that they will attack a Warrior who is roaring in anger. The probability increases by 15 percentage points at each level.
guide.raven.effect: At the start of the game, you will randomly receive either a stable mutation or an unstable mutation.
guide.raven.intro: Ravens are adaptable and perceptive, combining agility with a steady mind. Ravens are adaptable, capable of stepping into whatever role the party requires.
guide.raven.lore: Shaped by lands that never rest, the Ravens are born of poison skies and shifting waters. Change clings to them like a second skin. Senses sharpened, flesh remade by each breath of tainted air. Some develop new senses, and others gain unnatural resistances. No two Ravens are ever truly the same.
guide.recipe-scroll-intro: A fragment of alchemical knowledge. It describes the ingredients required to brew a potion with a Mortar and Pestle.
guide.recipe-scroll-use: Check the materials on the scroll in the item menu, and then use a mortar and pestle to synthesize them according to the recipe.
guide.recipe_minor_healing.intro: Restores a bit of health-just enough to regret picking a fight with that ogre.
guide.recipe_potion_heal_and_endurance.e: Restore 10–15 health points, Restore 15–20 stamina points
guide.recipe_potion_heal_and_endurance.i: A robust potion that can repair flesh and straighten the spine. It’s best to drink it when the battle is still ongoing and you refuse to give up.
guide.recipe_potion_heal_and_mana.effect: Restore 10–15 health points, Restore 15–20 mana points
guide.recipe_potion_heal_and_mana.intro: A soothing draught that restores both body and mind. Ideal when the wounds are fresh and the spells are running dry.
guide.riposte_stance.effects: On the first close-combat attack in this round, immediately counter-attack once. The counter-attack damage is 100% to 140%, with a 10-point increase for each level.
guide.ronan_helmet.note: Open Ronan's weapon store and unlock achievements.
guide.ronan_helmet.steps: Go to the village to find Ronan and inquire about the helmet.
guide.ronan_helmet.steps-2: Head to the west side of Fangroot Forest. Investigate near the isolated twisted dead trees and retrieve the helmet.
guide.ronan_helmet.steps-3: Return to the village and hand the helmet to Ronan.
guide.saps_endurance.effects: After receiving the power of the ancient trees in Caerlin Woods, the maximum mana or stamina value used by the character is permanently increased by 5 points.
guide.shades_shelter.effects: Fire, frost, lightning, blood, and poison resistance is permanently increased by 2% each.
guide.shielding_barrier.effects: The caster absorbs 5–25 damage, increasing by 5 per skill level. The barrier lasts 3 turns or until depleted.
guide.shielding_barrier.effects-2: The “Runeguard Tunic” also provides this barrier, with a absorption capacity of 10 points.
guide.shop_dwarf_brenna.intro: Trade with Brenna at the Dwarf Camp. Moonsteel armor can be crafted using the Forging option.
guide.shop_grgla.intro: Defeat the tree monsters at the Grimfen to ward off their attacks. Then talk to Grgla and choose to trade with him.
guide.shop_village_armorer.intro: Complete the "Heart of the Barbarian". Return the helmet to Ronan, then choose to trade to open the weapon store.
guide.shop_village_barlo.intro: Talk to Barlo and choose to trade with him.
guide.shop_village_khelebar.intro: Talk to Khelebar and choose to trade with him.
guide.shop_village_tavern.intro: Enter the tavern and purchase food and recipes from the shop owner. The cost for accommodation is 10 gold coins.
guide.shroom_five_mushrooms.note: Returning all five mushrooms to their mother grants Mushroom Bond to the whole party and unlocks Family Reunion. Turning them in to Barlo closes this route.
guide.shroom_five_mushrooms.stage: Return the five mushrooms to the Swampling
guide.shroom_five_mushrooms.steps: Talk to the Swampling at the edge of the forest in the village. Promise to find the five children.
guide.shroom_five_mushrooms.steps-2: Find five different living mushrooms in the village, bring them to Swampling to obtain the connection with golden spores.
guide.shroom_five_mushrooms.steps-3: If you give the mushrooms to Barlo or kill Swampling, you won’t be able to obtain this result.
guide.skirmishers_step.effects: Gain +10 evasion for 1 turn. The next normal attack deals +20% damage. Each skill level adds 10 evasion and 10 percentage points of damage. Does not stack.
guide.slugman.effect: Immune to damage from attacks. Fire damage is doubled.
guide.slugman.intro: Slugmen are naturally inclined toward magic. Their slow movements limit agility, but their endurance and steady minds make them well suited for sustained roles.
guide.slugman.lore: Slugmen dwell in colonies beneath the earth. They build in spirals and circles, reflecting the endless cycles of life. They see the fleeting lives of others as sparks against the long arc of their own existence.
guide.stun.effects: During the dizziness period, movement is impossible. When dizziness occurs repeatedly, the remaining time is longer, but the number of turns is not added together. The base duration is 1 turn.
guide.thief-skill_backstab_the_weak.intr: Dagger attack with increased critical chance for each negative trait on the target.
guide.thief-skill_backstab_the_weak.tabl: Additional attack probability for each negative state
guide.thief-skill_bleeding_dash.intro: Dagger or sword attack with a chance to inflict Bleed.
guide.thief-skill_bleeding_dash.notes: - Usable only with daggers or swords
guide.thief-skill_cloak_of_swiftness_thi: Increases the thief's evasion, unarmed damage, melee hit chance and melee critical hit chance.
guide.thief-skill_evasive_roll.intro: Swift maneuver that increases evasion for 2 rounds and raises its maximum cap.
guide.thief-skill_evasive_roll.notes:
- Does not consume an action
Each skill level increases the maximum evasion +2%
guide.thief-skill_mark_the_dead.intro: Marks a close enemy, increasing all damage they take.
guide.thief-skill_nightshade_mastery.int: Dagger and sword attacks can apply a random negative status.
guide.thief-skill_nightshade_mastery.not:
Only applicable to daggers and swords
One negative state can be applied per attack
Possible negative states: Poisoned, Bleeding, Blindness or Burning
Status strength and duration are random (1-3 turns)
guide.thief-skill_shadow_instinct.intro: Attacks gain critical chance and partially ignore armor.
guide.thief-skill_shadow_lunge.intro: Dagger attack that deals bonus damage to bleeding or poisoned enemies.
guide.thief-skill_shadow_lunge.table: Additional damage for bleeding or poisoned enemy
guide.thief-skill_smoke_bomb.intro: Throws a ranged smoke bomb with a chance to Blind up to two enemies for 2 rounds.
guide.thief-skill_smoke_bomb.notes:
The chance of being blinded is reduced by the enemy's evasion
Long-range attacks
It affects a maximum of two enemies
Blinding reduces the hit rates of melee and long-range attacks by 50%
guide.thief.intro:
Thieves excel in brute force attacks, Evasive techniques, Blood-based damage, Additionally, they deal extra damage to already wounded targets. They are outstanding in battles using swords and daggers.

Agility is their primary trait, However, if they plan to use heavier weapons and armor,, Thieves should also consider strength.
guide.thief.lore: The Thief is a fast and agile combatant who relies on evasion instead of armor. He can fight on the front line, using daggers and light blades to deliver devastating precision strikes.
guide.torren_fragment.note: Each option grants 20 XP and is available when the party has the required class.
guide.torren_fragment.note-2: Original price: 300 Gold Coins. Thieves can negotiate a payment of 250 Gold Coins.
guide.torren_fragment.stage: Wizards can identify fragments or negotiate prices with Thieves
guide.torren_fragment.stage-2: Purchase the Fourth Runic Segment from Torren
guide.torren_fragment.steps: When encountering Torren again at “Roots of Underkeep”, ask for the Key Fragment of the Tower and negotiate the price.
guide.torren_fragment.steps-2: Pay 300 Gold Coins to obtain the Fourth Runic Segment. The group can negotiate with the Thief first, and then pay 250 Gold Coins.
guide.ui.description:
Increases damage with Strength-scaling melee weapons, and contributes to Health gained per level.

Many weapons and armor pieces require a minimum Strength. Some weapons scale with Dexterity but still require Strength to equip.
guide.ui.description-10:
Successful ranged attacks have a chance to deal 175% damage. Some enemies are immune to critical damage.

Ranged Critical Chance = Dexterity / 7 + Bonuses
guide.ui.description-11:
Reduces incoming physical damage. Higher Armor provides greater protection.

Armor reduces damage but does not affect the chance to be hit.
guide.ui.description-12:
Reduces the chance of being hit by melee and ranged attacks. Does not protect against spells.

Base Evasion = Dexterity x 2%

Maximum Evasion = 60%
guide.ui.description-13: The base value is determined by the character's Wisdom x2.
guide.ui.description-14: The base value is determined by the character's Endurance x2.
guide.ui.description-2:
Improves ranged accuracy, damage with Dexterity-scaling weapons, evasion, and critical hits.

Certain weapons, armor, and accessories require a minimum Dexterity.

Ranged Hit Chance = Dexterity x 9 - enemy evasion

Evasion = Dexterity x 2

Critical Chance = Dexterity / 10

Ranged Critical Chance = Dexterity / 7
guide.ui.description-3:
Increases Health and Stamina gained per level, improves Stamina recovery when resting, increases Blood Magic Resistance, and helps reduce the duration of Poison and other negative effects.

Unlike other stats, Endurance does not affect equipment requirements.
guide.ui.description-4:
Increases Mana gained per level and Mana recovered when resting. Improves elemental and poison resistances.

Many magical weapons and accessories require Wisdom.

Mana Gain = 2 + (Wisdom x 1)

Elemental Resistance = Wisdom x 2
guide.ui.description-5:
Each level grants 1 Skill Point, +1 Base Damage, and increases your Health and Mana or Stamina.

Base stats do not increase when leveling up. Equipment and other bonuses can raise them.
guide.ui.description-6: Gained by defeating enemies, completing quests, and through various decisions made throughout the game.
guide.ui.description-7:
Each basic strike feeds it.

Build Zeal through combat and spend it to deliver devastating, righteous power.
guide.ui.description-8:
Each weapon scales with either Strength or Dexterity. Base Damage also depends on weapon damage, level, and other bonuses.

Armor Piercing reduces enemy Armor before damage is calculated.

Sharpness adds bonus damage only if your attack penetrates Armor.

Base Melee Hit Chance = 100% - Enemy Evasion
guide.ui.description-9:
Successful melee attacks have a chance to deal 175% damage. Some enemies are immune to critical damage.

Critical Chance = Dexterity / 10 + Bonuses
guide.ui.intro: Your raw physical power. Also the stat that decides who opens the pickle jars.
guide.ui.intro-10: That perfect shot that makes enemies reconsider their life choices.
guide.ui.intro-11: Your first and last line of defense.
guide.ui.intro-12: Your ability to avoid being hit. The higher it is, the more your enemies hit thin air while you just laugh!
guide.ui.intro-13: Reduces fire based damage. Keeps you from becoming medium-rare.
guide.ui.intro-14: The ability to stay cool under pressure.
guide.ui.intro-15: Getting zapped every five seconds isn't exactly a fun way to spend your adventure.
guide.ui.intro-16: Sometimes, the only thing worse than being poisoned is realizing you forgot to buy an antidote.
guide.ui.intro-17: Helps keep your blood inside your body, where it belongs.
guide.ui.intro-2: The art of not tripping over your own feet and pretending it was part of the plan.
guide.ui.intro-3: Your staying power. The stat that decides whether you're exhausted or still going.
guide.ui.intro-4: The inner voice that says "maybe don't lick that glowing crystal."
guide.ui.intro-5: Each step forward makes you stronger.
guide.ui.intro-6: The magical currency that turns you from a newbie with a wooden sword into someone who can bully dragons.
guide.ui.intro-7: A unique resource used by Paladins.
guide.ui.intro-8: The higher, the more enemies regret crossing your path!
guide.ui.intro-9: How often you hit like a legendary hero instead of an average one.

guide.ui.level-up-skill-point: Each time a Character Levels Up, 1 Skill Point Is Earned.

guide.ui.show-race-3: Experience required to reach this level
guide.undead.effects: Mark Undead enemies. Paladins can use "Stun Undead", consuming Exhaust to stun such targets.
guide.underkeep_keys.stage: First Detailed Inspection of the Tower Gate Lock
guide.underkeep_keys.stage-2: Enclose the four runes and open the tower's gate
guide.underkeep_keys.steps: In "Roots of Underkeep," investigate the four grooves on the tower's gate.
guide.underkeep_keys.steps-2: The first fragment is in a chest in the Chambers of Endless Sleep, the second in The Mireheart, and the third in the Sanctum of the Last Flame. Buy the fourth from Torren outside the tower. Check the individual item entries for exact locations.
guide.underkeep_keys.steps-3: Return to the tower gate and embed the four runes one by one to open the tower entrance.
guide.underkeep_main_quest.note: Give up beer or pay 10 gold coins to earn 10 experience points. Revealing Darrow's identity or the Stone Hammer Clan earns 40 experience points. Identifying the guards by dwarves can also earn 20 experience points.
guide.underkeep_main_quest.note-2: Share with "The Tower's Seal"; an additional 40 experience points for unlocking the door lock are included in this mission.
guide.underkeep_main_quest.stage: Inquire about the dwarf expedition team with Aldren in the village
guide.underkeep_main_quest.stage-10: Ask Durok about the expedition team
guide.underkeep_main_quest.stage-11: Arrive at the Forge of Creation and receive Durok's weapon
guide.underkeep_main_quest.stage-2: Ask Barlo about the Dwarf Expedition Team in the village
guide.underkeep_main_quest.stage-3: Ask the tavern owner about the Dwarf Expedition Team in the village
guide.underkeep_main_quest.stage-4: Ask Ronan about the Dwarf Expedition Team in the village
guide.underkeep_main_quest.stage-5: Ask Khelebar about the Dwarf Expedition Team in the village
guide.underkeep_main_quest.stage-6: Negotiate with the guard at the Valley Guard
guide.underkeep_main_quest.stage-9: Ask Durok about the Forge of Creation
guide.underkeep_main_quest.steps: Travel from Fangroot Forest to the Village of Underkeep. Inquire with the village chief Aldren and the shopkeeper about the missing dwarf expedition team. Then head west to find the camp in Duskhollow Woods.
guide.underkeep_main_quest.steps-2: Talk to Korr and Durok about “The Last Forge Burns”. After dealing with the dragon, report back to Durok and enter the dwarven ruins.
guide.underkeep_main_quest.steps-3: Complete the “Trial of Eight Keys” outside the Soul Forge. Proceed deeper into the furnace through The Silent Riddles. Find the Forge of Creation and report back to Durok to obtain the Soulcleaver.
guide.underkeep_main_quest.steps-4: Complete “The Tower’s Seal” and climb to Tower Level 5 to talk with the Archmage.
guide.underkeep_main_quest.steps-5: After the passage at the bottom of the tower opens, return to the entrance of the tower and find Torren. During the conversation, choose either “Enough. Die.” or “That’s it.” to initiate battle.
guide.unholy_convergence.effects: Reduce the physical damage of enemies at close range by 20% over 2 rounds. Reduce resistance to fire, frost, lightning, blood, and toxins by 3 points each. With each level increase, reduce the physical damage by an additional 5 percentage points and the resistance by 3 percentage points.
guide.unskilled.effects: Any skills cannot be used during the period of Mental Fog. The basic duration is 1 round, but the actual number of rounds depends on the source.
guide.village_guard_entry.note: It can be accessed through the village entrance.
guide.village_guard_entry.note-2: Paying for it earns 40 experience points, and completing the dialogue further earns 120 experience points. It costs 30 gold coins, and Thieves can pay 20.
guide.village_guard_entry.stage: After repelling the Burrower, report to Garrick
guide.village_guard_entry.steps: Find the guard Garrick at the entrance of Fangroot Forest. After accepting the mission, remove the eight Burrowers he has designated along the southern path.
guide.village_guard_entry.steps-2: Return to the entrance and report to Garrick, then you can proceed. You can also pay 30 gold coins to pass through during negotiations; the team has an option of 20 gold coins for Thief.
guide.void_shard_effect.effects: When the swamp leader opens its mouth, throw a Voidshard at it. Its attacks will switch from poison damage to void damage.
guide.void_veil.effects: Create a barrier for a teammate to absorb any type of damage. The barrier can last up to 3 turns. Levels 1–5 of the skill can absorb 5–25 points of damage, with an increase of 5 points per level.
guide.voidcaller-skill_aura_of_blades.in: Grants a melee attack bonus to all party members.
guide.voidcaller-skill_aura_of_blades.no:
Only one aura can be activated at the same time
The Voidcaller can change its aura during level-up
Increasing one aura will also increase the effectiveness of other auras
Periodically creates a barrier that absorbs incoming damage.
guide.voidcaller-skill_aura_of_thorns.in: Reflects a portion of received melee damage.
guide.voidcaller-skill_null_bolt.intro: Ranged Void attack that ignores enemy defenses.
guide.voidcaller-skill_power_of_the_void: Increases the healing and damage effects of all void spells.
guide.voidcaller-skill_unholy_convergenc: Weakens a close enemy by reducing their physical damage and resistances for 2 rounds.
guide.voidcaller-skill_void_mend.intro: Restores health to an ally and can remove negative effects at higher levels.
guide.voidcaller-skill_void_mend.notes:
Restores 4 health points
Level 2: Removes bleeding
Level 3: Removes burning
Level 4: Removes poisoning
Level 5: Remove dizziness
guide.voidcaller-skill_void_veil.intro: Grants an ally a temporary damage-absorbing barrier.
guide.voidcaller.intro: Voidcallers specialize in protective barriers, healing, disruptive void effects, and auras that influence the entire party. Their strength lies in reinforcing allies while weakening enemies.
guide.voidcaller.lore: The Voidcaller draws power from forces beyond mortal understanding. Rather than overwhelming enemies with brute magic, the Voidcaller manipulates space, protection, and unseen energies to tilt the battle in the party's favor.
guide.warrior-skill_battle_roar.intro: Raises the party's morale, increasing combat performance for 3 rounds.
guide.warrior-skill_champions_grip.intro: Increases physical damage and grants stun immunity for 4 rounds.
guide.warrior-skill_cleave.intro: Attacks two enemies simultaneously with two-handed weapons, causing 80% damage.
guide.warrior-skill_cleave.notes: - Usable only with two-handed melee weapon
guide.warrior-skill_flow_of_life.intro: Increases the warrior's maximum health and elemental resistances.
guide.warrior-skill_flurry_thrust.intro: Performs two consecutive strikes with a sword. The secondary strike doesn't trigger weapon effects and critical hits.
guide.warrior-skill_provoking_shout.intr: Lets out a shout that redirects enemy attacks to the warrior for 2 rounds.
guide.warrior-skill_riposte.intro: One-handed attack that ignores enemy armor and triggers one melee counterattack this round.
guide.warrior-skill_shield_bash.intro: Strikes the enemy with a shield, with 9% chance to stun for 1 rounds. Also grants a passive armor bonus when wielding a shield.
guide.warrior-skill_skull_rattle.intro: A single blow with the hammer, causing 110% damage and a 9% chance to stun the target.
guide.warrior-skill_slice_and_dice.intro: Attack with an axe, causing 110% damage and ignoring some enemy armor.
guide.warrior.intro: Warriors specialize in weapon mastery, defensive techniques, and sustained melee combat. Proficient with a wide range of weapons, they control the battlefield through durability and direct confrontation.
guide.warrior.lore: The Warrior is a disciplined frontline fighter who relies on strength and heavy armor. The Warrior stands firm where the line must hold and makes the enemy break against him.
guide.wizard-skill_arcane_lock.intro: Paralyzes an enemy, it cannot move for 1 round. Has a 20% chance to also Stun the target.
guide.wizard-skill_arcane_lock.notes:
Long-range spell
Stunned targets can still move
guide.wizard-skill_dragon_arcana.intro: Increases the damage of all elemental spells and improves Burn and Freeze chances on spells that can apply them.
guide.wizard-skill_fire_spark.intro: Ignites a single enemy in front of the caster, dealing 7–13 fire damage with a 20% chance to burn the target.
guide.wizard-skill_fireball.intro: Hurls a blazing sphere that explodes on impact, dealing 16–22 fire damage to two enemies in range with a 20% chance to burn them.
guide.wizard-skill_fireball.notes: At character level 6, a Wizard can learn only the first rank of Fireball.
guide.wizard-skill_ice_shard.intro: Launches a shard of enchanted ice, dealing 4–8 ice damage with a 10% chance to freeze the target.
guide.wizard-skill_ice_tower.intro: Freezes the ground ahead, dealing 10–14 ice damage to all enemies caught in it with a 12% chance to freeze.
guide.wizard-skill_invisibility.intro: Renders the party completely unseen, untouchable by hostile eyes or spells. As long as they remain still and passive, the illusion holds. The moment they attack, or take direct action, the enchantment unravels.
guide.wizard-skill_shielding_barrier.int: Surrounds the caster with a shimmering barrier for 3 rounds, absorbing up to 5 damage of any type.
guide.wizard-skill_static_shock.intro: Unleashes a surge of electricity, dealing 3–12 lightning damage to two enemies in front of the caster.
guide.wizard-skill_storm_chain.intro: Chain lightning that strikes two enemies, with a 10% chance to strike the same targets again.
guide.wizard.intro: Wizards specialize in direct burst damage through fire, ice, and lightning magic. Their spells deliver high immediate impact, making them the primary source of ranged magical offense.
guide.wizard.lore: The Wizard commands elemental forces through discipline and knowledge. From a safe distance, the Wizard unleashes destructive spells that strike with overwhelming force.
guide.zerethic_regeneration.effects: When Zeresix started the battle, he carried regeneration, with an initial strength of 60. Each time he activated a red stone coffin connected to him, his regeneration strength was reduced by 10 points.
